capture_attempt_summaries.label: cc-raw-commit-body-check
argv:
import hashlib,json,pathlib,subprocess
raw=subprocess.check_output(["git","cat-file","commit","HEAD"])
parts=raw.split(b"\\n\\n",1)
assert len(parts)==2
header,body=parts
expected=pathlib.Path("/private/tmp/nms-slice39-cc-source-message.txt").read_bytes()
assert body==expected
paths=subprocess.check_output(["git","diff-tree","--no-commit-id","--name-only","-r","HEAD"]).decode().splitlines()
assert paths==["crates/nms-copilot/src/commands.rs","crates/nms-copilot/src/completer.rs","crates/nms-copilot/src/prompt.rs"]
lines=body.rstrip(b"\\n").splitlines()
assert lines[-2:]==[b"Co-authored-by: Codex <noreply@openai.com>",b"Co-authored-by: Billo AI <ai-engineering@billo.systems>"]
assert body.count(b"Co-authored-by: Codex <noreply@openai.com>")==1 and body.count(b"Co-authored-by: Billo AI <ai-engineering@billo.systems>")==1
print(json.dumps({"commit":subprocess.check_output(["git","rev-parse","HEAD"]).decode().strip(),"stored_body_matches_message":True,"paths":paths,"stored_body_bytes":len(body),"body_sha256":hashlib.sha256(body).hexdigest(),"trailers_once_consecutive":True}))
